title: Fair Measure
logline: At a weekly market, one vendor's old balance scales are the only ones nobody double-checks, and a neighbouring stallholder's quiet suggestion to shave a little weight off gets a flat no.
human_question: What does it look like to keep doing the harder, honest thing when the easier dishonest one is right there, unnoticed?

premise.story: A vendor's ordinary market day, weighing and selling, including one real moment where a shortcut is available and refused.
premise.place: A weekly open-air market (pola): noise, produce, scales, cash changing hands.
premise.experience: The unremarkable rhythm of trade, with one small, real test inside it.

concept_links.why: Right livelihood is the conscious refusal of a specific wrong done for a living, not simply 'having an honest job'; naturally blameless trade on its own is not this abstinence [C024-P:L45].
In ordinary sense-sphere minds, right livelihood arises only occasionally, one wrong refrained from at a time, not as a general virtuous mood running through the whole day [C027-M:L17].

what_camera_could_observe: The moment a shortcut is offered or considered, and refused
what_must_be_real: An actual market day and the vendor's actual, ongoing practice. No staged temptation or arranged 'test'.

possible_arc.opening: A normal market morning, stalls setting up.
possible_arc.turn: A moment where cheating would be easy and likely unnoticed.
possible_arc.ending_open: Whatever the vendor actually does and says, in their own words.

requirements: A weekly market with an established, trusted vendor willing to be filmed
A real, observed moment rather than a recreated or hypothetical one
Cooperation from neighbouring stallholders and market organisers

suggestions.name: A weekly pola market
suggestions.why: Region-level suggestion; weekly open-air markets of this kind are common across these provinces.
suggestions.verify: No specific market or vendor has been identified or confirmed.

risks: Implying that other vendors cheat, which would be unfair without evidence
Staging a 'temptation' would falsify the entire premise of the film
drop_if: No vendor's real, ongoing practice can be observed without staging

connections.note: Both show restraint from a specific wrong, one in a single moment, the other as an ongoing daily practice.
Both concern honest dealing chosen over an available, more profitable wrong, at the level of a trade and of a community.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: All content is editorial proposal. Location suggestions are AI suggestions only; selection belongs to Chathura.
